name: swarnil
description: An editorial Ghost theme for creators who publish in more than one shape — writing, video and notes — held together by a call-sheet grid and a single signal colour.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.build:css: npm run ds:sync && postcss assets/css/index.css -o assets/built/index.css --env production
scripts.lint: npm run lint:css && npm run lint:hbs
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run test:ci

color_scheme.description: Which colour scheme new visitors see before they choose one.

show_color_scheme_toggle.description: Let readers switch between light and dark from the header.

typeface_pairing.description: The display face used for headlines. Body text stays the same.

header_style.description: How the site header sits on the page.

list_sidebar.description: Show a sidebar beside the homepage and archives, with topics, recent posts and the newsletter.

footer_note.description: A short line above the footer navigation. Leave blank to hide it.

homepage_layout.description: The overall shape of the homepage.

homepage_lead.description: What occupies the large lead slot at the top.

homepage_intro.description: One or two sentences under the site title. Leave blank to hide it.

homepage_shelf_tags.description: Tag slugs shown as horizontal shelves. Comma-separated, no spaces, e.g. video,notes

show_subscribe_band.description: Show the newsletter band near the foot of the homepage.

post_layout.description: Default layout for posts. Individual posts can override this with an internal tag.

show_reading_time.description: Show estimated reading time in the post byline.

show_table_of_contents.description: Build a contents list from the headings in each post.

show_author_card.description: Show the author card beneath the post.

show_read_next.description: Show related posts beneath the post.

designSystem.comment: The exact design-system commit assets/built/index.css is built from. CI clones this ref so the build is reproducible; bump it deliberately, rebuild, and commit the result.
